desc: The KRISS Vector 22 CRB Duotone is a dedicated, semi-automatic, rimfire sporting rifle that incorporates the iconic aesthetics and ergonomics of the KRISS Vector carbine design, with the square shroud and ambidextrous folding stock. The Vector 22 is a one of a kind firearm engineered to fire the .22LR cartridge, and designed for rimfire competition, training, and small game hunting. The Vector 22 offers precision, performance, and value in an iconic design.
